notes: ACHA's empty units are covered, but as part of HUD's July 2025 substantial-default and takeover finding: 71.4% occupancy vs a 96% goal (CBS Philadelphia, NJ Globe). No source found with the lead's numbers: 339 regular vacancies of 1,473, 23%, highest of 91 peer authorities, 5.9x the peer median, or Stanley Holmes 50% occupied. The lead counts only 'regular' vacancies (no approved reason), while the press figure is total occupancy, so the two are different definitions. A 2023 HUD compliance review (Press of AC, paywalled) reportedly said ACHA had not actively leased units since 2020; that sentence came from search snippets only. HUD's own release (hud.gov/news/hud-no-25-110, 2025-07-25) was fetched: it covers heat, mold and pests, with no vacancy sentence. Breaking AC (2025-07-29) has ACHA's chair disputing HUD findings in general, with no vacancy detail. Press of AC dates are not visible behind the paywall; timestamps in the article IDs suggest June 2023 (fails HUD rules) and Sept 2023 (demolish one-third). Their pages redirect to tollbit.pressofatlanticcity.com, which refuses unauthenticated fetches. No July-September 2026 coverage found on vacancies.
